recipe.visualDefinition: A trio of women in glamorous, metallic, and feathered attire posed within a trapezoidal frame against a deep space background featuring glowing nebulae and thin, intersecting laser-grid lines.
coreVisualRelationships: Three subjects arranged in a tight, overlapping triangular formation
Trapezoidal central frame cutting through a larger starfield background
High-contrast lighting creating deep shadows and bright specular highlights on metallic fabrics
Geometric laser lines intersecting the subjects and the background
coreInvariants: Deep space background with soft-focus nebulae
Metallic and textured costume materials (lamé, sequins, feathers)
Diagonal, thin cyan or green laser-like lines
Soft, diffused glow around the central subjects

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three subjects occupy the central 70% of the frame, arranged from waist-up in a layered group portrait.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central figure in white/orange with a crochet headpiece acts as the focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the diagonal tilt of the main title text down through the subjects' faces and along the intersecting laser lines.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dark, star-filled corners outside the central trapezoid provide breathing room for secondary text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep indigo and black space background with white star clusters.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm tones in the costumes: copper, gold, and orange.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright pink for main text outlines and thin cyan for laser lines.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the dark space and the brightly lit, saturated subjects.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Slanted, condensed sans-serif with sharp terminals
letterConstructionRules: Double-line construction with a thick pink outer stroke and a thin white inner line
Sharp, angular corners on letters like 'S' and 'A'
Uniform stroke weight throughout the skeleton
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'G' has a sharp, inward-pointing spur

composition.relationshipToImage: aligned with the top edge of the inner frame

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Aggressive, slanted display lettering paired with a clean, wide-tracked geometric sans-serif for secondary information.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the heavy, condensed base needed for the display text.
Matches the wide-tracked, futuristic feel of the subtitle text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A group portrait of three women in 1970s disco-glam outfits (sequins, feathers, metallic fabrics) inside a white-bordered trapezoidal frame. The background outside the frame is a dark nebula with stars and thin cyan laser lines crisscrossing the composition.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the main title in the top left at a 15-degree upward angle using a custom-drawn, slanted, pink-outlined sans-serif. Add secondary text in the top right, following the angle of the frame, in a wide-tracked cyan sans-serif.

verificationChecks: Is the main text slanted and outlined in pink?
Is there a clear trapezoidal frame separating the subjects from the outer space?
Are the laser lines thin and cyan/green?
Do the costumes have high-specular metallic reflections?

adjustableVariables: Specific textures of the costumes (more feathers vs. more sequins)
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original subjects
Exact wording of the original album titles
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text does not look like a standard modern font.
Check that the trapezoid frame is not perfectly centered, creating dynamic tension.
Verify the 'glow' around the subjects feels like a physical lens flare or airbrush effect.
Confirm the laser lines pass both behind and in front of subjects for depth.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a trio-based glamour portrait with a geometric frame, set against a cosmic backdrop, and finish with aggressive, slanted, outlined display typography.
